digest.component_or_area: rebar event store and code-review audit reconciliation
propositions: Structured code-review telemetry from preserved AWS review-bot clone must be transplanted to current tickets epoch via selective content-hashed allowlist containing exactly 5 CREATE, 7 REVIEW_RESULT, and 9 LINK events
All 21 allowlisted events must be written atomically through batch_write_and_push using event_prepare.py without re-deriving timestamps, UUIDs, authors, or signatures to preserve signed source bytes
Preflight and rehearsal validation must confirm exact type counts, zero path collisions, valid artifact ownership, and strict fsck compliance before live publication
Publication must result in five new code-review artifacts and seven transplanted review results across six total artifacts with nine bidirectional relates_to edges, verifiable from fresh clone
Non-resurrection verification must confirm zero restoration of 1,520 removed comment aliases, 66 divergent enrichment events, and stale DONE_ENRICH before accepting transplant as complete
